nodes.label: Privilege Guest Card Face (design export)
nodes.rationale: Figma export of the front of the Privilege Guest membership card, 540x340 with a 24-unit rounded corner. Vector-only (zero <text> elements: 1415 outlined paths, 964 luminance masks, 965 groups) over a 48-stop charcoal linear gradient, plus two 486x242 base64 PNGs (image0_42_1891 artwork + image1_42_1891 luminance mask) carrying the licensed STEIGENBERGER wordmark. Palette: 183 gold #B4954F paths (facade line art and 'PRIVILEGE GUEST' lettering laid into the building), 20 highlight #EBD79B, 15 silver #C0C5C7, cream #EDEAE4, muted gold #D6BE8A. This is the design source of record, still carrying specimen personalisation and a full-bleed white backing rectangle.

nodes.label: Specimen Name and Number
nodes.source_location: 26 paths at y approx 281-295: 19 fill=#EDEAE4 at x 26-191, 7 fill=#D6BE8A at x 461-514
nodes.rationale: The placeholder cardholder identity baked into the design export as outlined glyphs rather than live text: a cream #EDEAE4 name at the lower left and a muted-gold #D6BE8A member number at the lower right, sharing one baseline band. These are the only per-member values on the face, and being outlines they cannot be re-typed — which is precisely why the shipped asset deletes them. The four #EDEAE4 paths spelling DOHA sit in the same colour but were deliberately kept: that is lockup, not data.
